questions.q: What term refers to the practice of using energy efficiently and meeting current energy needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs?
Which of the following energy sources is classified as renewable and sustainable for long-term use?
What is the primary environmental benefit of using renewable energy sources instead of fossil fuels?
a: They reduce greenhouse gas emissions and pollution

questions.q: Which of the following everyday practices promotes energy conservation in domestic households?
a: Leaving all lights and fans on overnight
Using incandescent bulbs instead of LED lights
Keeping doors and windows wide open while air conditioning runs
Switching off electrical appliances at the socket when not in use

questions.q: What name is given to energy derived from natural sources that replenish themselves continuously, such as sunlight, wind, and flowing water?
Which of the following is a major non-renewable energy source widely used for electricity generation and transportation?
What term describes the measure of how much useful work is obtained from a given amount of total energy input?
Which of the following actions contributes to energy wastage in commercial buildings?
a: Leaving high-power electric heaters and lights running in empty rooms

questions.q: What is the primary function of a solar panel (photovoltaic cell) in sustainable energy systems?
a: Converting sunlight directly into electrical energy

questions.q: Which renewable energy technology harnesses the kinetic energy of moving air to generate electricity?
Why is the reliance on fossil fuels considered unsustainable for the future?
a: They are being consumed much faster than they can naturally form
They are too cheap to manage

questions.q: Which of the following materials is commonly used to insulate buildings and reduce the energy needed for heating or cooling?
What sustainable practice involves capturing organic waste, such as animal dung and plant material, to produce biogas for cooking and lighting?
Which term describes energy sources that exist in limited amounts and will eventually run out once consumed?
What is the main advantage of using energy-saving LED lamps over traditional incandescent bulbs?
a: They burn out after a few hours
They consume significantly less energy and last much longer

questions.q: Which of the following government policies encourages energy sustainability among citizens and industries?
a: Subsidizing the importation of crude oil
Penalizing the use of solar panels
Providing incentives for renewable energy adoption and enforcing energy efficiency standards

questions.q: What clean energy technology uses the potential energy of impounded water in rivers to spin turbines and generate electricity?
Which of the following is a direct consequence of excessive fossil fuel combustion on global climate systems?
What term describes the total set of greenhouse gas emissions caused directly and indirectly by an individual, organization, or product?
Which of the following practices represents sustainable energy management in industrial manufacturing?
a: Disposing of waste heat into the atmosphere without recovery
Operating machinery continuously at maximum capacity when idle
Implementing cogeneration systems to reuse waste heat for power

questions.q: What name is given to heat energy obtained from beneath the Earth's crust, used for generating sustainable electricity?
Why is energy conservation considered a crucial pillar of sustainable development?
a: It reduces resource depletion and environmental degradation
It accelerates the burning of coal

questions.q: Which of the following appliances typically consumes the most electrical energy in a home and requires energy-efficient management?
a: Air conditioner or electric water heater

questions.q: What is the primary environmental risk associated with poorly managed hydroelectric dam projects?
a: Displacement of local communities and disruption of aquatic ecosystems

questions.q: Which international initiative or practice focuses on reducing net carbon emissions to zero to combat climate change?
Which of the following is an effective way to harness solar energy for heating domestic water supplies?
a: Installing solar water heating panels on rooftops

questions.q: What role do energy efficient star ratings on electronic home appliances play for consumers?
a: They indicate the physical weight of the appliance
They show the maximum sound volume
They help consumers identify appliances that consume less electricity and save energy

questions.q: Which of the following describes a smart grid system in sustainable energy distribution?
a: A manual switchboard operated by hand
An outdated wiring system prone to blackouts
A network that relies entirely on burning diesel generators
An automated digital electricity network that efficiently monitors and manages energy supply and demand

questions.q: What sustainable transport strategy helps reduce traffic congestion and vehicular fossil fuel consumption in cities?
a: Promoting public mass transit, carpooling, and cycling
Encouraging every citizen to drive separate large trucks
Leaving car engines idling in traffic

questions.q: Which of the following renewable energy sources depends directly on the gravitational pull of the moon and the sun?
What is the main objective of energy auditing in large facilities?
a: To assess energy usage patterns and identify areas where energy waste can be reduced
To test the water plumbing system

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of converting waste biomass into useful liquid fuel for sustainable transport?
a: Refining crude oil from deep wells
Mining solid coal from underground seams
Drilling natural gas from rock beds
Producing bio-ethanol or biodiesel from agricultural crops and organic waste

questions.q: What term refers to energy resources that are inexhaustible and cause little to no environmental pollution?
Why is the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy critical for island nations and coastal communities?
a: To mitigate rising sea levels and extreme weather caused by climate change

questions.q: Which of the following building design concepts maximizes natural sunlight and heat to reduce artificial lighting and heating needs?
Which of the following practices undermines energy sustainability at the national level?
a: Relying heavily on subsidized, inefficient fossil fuel power plants without emission controls

questions.q: What name is given to energy generated from organic matter, such as wood, crop residue, and animal waste?
Which of the following is a key benefit of decentralized renewable energy systems (such as standalone solar home systems)?
a: They require massive central power grids to function
They provide reliable electricity to remote rural communities without extensive grid lines
They depend entirely on coal imports

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of energy storage technologies (such as lithium-ion batteries) in renewable energy systems?
a: To burn excess electricity into heat
To store surplus energy generated from intermittent sources like solar and wind for later use
To increase the voltage of power lines randomly

questions.q: Which of the following best defines the term 'energy conservation'?
a: Using as much electricity as possible before it expires
The deliberate reduction of energy consumption through efficient behavior and technology
